A hospitality rebrand — naming & identity (2018).

A strategic naming and identity exploration for a hotel group: a shortlist of candidate names (Element, Essence, Celeste, Lusso…), then three worked routes — 'Hotel Craft' with an HC monogram, 'Hotel Kraft' as a single gold 'hk', and 'Point Hospitality', where the dot of the 'i' becomes a location pin and, on a closer look, a person. The fun half of branding: deciding what a thing is even called.

Brand naming & identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·62.
